source_request_text: 按照统一 service-sdk API -> TokenSeller Qwen-native Realtime relay -> 原生 Qwen Omni Realtime WebSocket 架构实施，并为未来 OpenAI Realtime 保留不侵入产品和 Qwen adapter 的扩展点；用户已批准 Realtime Provider Program 验收标准与四个 release slice。

terms.meaning: One ephemeral full-duplex media connection; it is not a durable Harness Session or Run.
The only owner of one Provider native wire contract.
An independently committed, tested, rollbackable delivery that consumes only immutable earlier artifacts.

before_after.before: Product owns mint, WSS and Provider event mapping.
before_after.after: Product owns device audio and UI; service-sdk owns Realtime protocol/session.

before_after.before: Legacy local voice is disabled and Realtime is absent.
before_after.after: A single phone-style Realtime UI consumes the same service-sdk.

before_after.before: Legacy GA-shaped relay maps to an older Qwen beta wire.
before_after.after: Legacy remains; a versioned Qwen-native route shares control-plane authorities.

preserved: Text Chat and durable Harness command authority
Product ownership of microphone, playback, UI and policy
removed: Extra manual start-speaking action in the phone-style UI

approval.scope: Realtime Provider Program acceptance criteria and four release slices

input_sensitive.rationale: 真实语音语义、打断时机和多轮上下文都会改变产品及 Provider 终态。

llm_payload_driven.rationale: Provider 的流式 transcript、audio、tool 和 terminal 事件直接驱动产品状态机。

stateful_init.rationale: 首次 wheel 注册、ephemeral mint、adapter capability 与隔离 userdata 冷启动均属于验收范围。
